h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kollam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kollam

items.pText: Kollam lies on the Kerala coast between the Arabian Sea and the Ashtamudi backwaters, with the cashew industry, fishing harbours and lakeside resorts all close together. For playground equipment, that means salt air, high humidity and two rainy seasons each year. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor play equipment in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,230 km away, and delivers it to Kollam by road.

We supply schools, housing projects, churches and temples with community grounds, and backwater resorts that want a family play corner. Tell us what kind of site you have and how many children will use it at once. We will suggest equipment, send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and install it through our team or a dealer in south India once you approve.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Looking after equipment in coastal Kollam

c: Kerala gets the south-west monsoon from June to September and more rain from the north-east monsoon in October and November. Near the sea, salt settles on every surface between showers. Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded plastic are the right materials here, since plastic cannot rust and zinc protects the steel underneath.

A little routine care adds years to any coastal installation. Rinse the equipment with fresh water every few weeks, check bolts after the monsoon and report any damage to our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921. Lakeside resorts often pick a themed set such as

items.q: Does salt air damage playground equipment in Kollam?
items.a: It damages bare or painted iron quickly. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up far better, especially if you rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time.

items.q: Can a backwater resort get a small play area for guests?
items.a: Yes. Share the space you have and the ages of children who usually visit. We will suggest a compact set and show the safe play area on a layout drawing.

items.q: Who installs FunPlay equipment in Kollam?
items.a: Our own installation team or a dealer in south India. The equipment is manufactured in Vasai, sent by road and installed self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground.
